about: Rule-defined cases built from real cards. Each starts from a real precon that reads Bracket 2 with no floor (Necron Dynasties, 40K 2022), adds real cards in place of Swamps, and states the bracket the rule gives. `authority: official` cases follow the Commander Brackets text; `authority: heuristic` cases pin a SpellControl rule the official text leaves open, so a change to that rule shows up here as a decision rather than as drift.

sources.ruling-2026-09-23: SpellControl ruling of 2026-09-23 (project memory: bracket precon calibration): commander plus at most two other cards floors at Bracket 4, matching Commander Spellbook's Ruthless rating

cases.rule: No Game Changer, two-card infinite, mass land denial or extra turns: Core is the landing point ("The power level of the average modern-day preconstructed deck sits here").
Core: "No cards from the Game Changers list." Upgraded: "Up to three cards from the Game Changers list."
Upgraded allows up to three Game Changers.
A fourth Game Changer is over Upgraded's limit; Optimized has none.

add: Tergrid, God of Fright // Tergrid's Lantern
cases.rule: Tergrid is on the list; a deck names it by its full Scryfall name, as every card source in the app does.
"You should not expect to see these cards [mass land denial] anywhere in Brackets 1-3."
Mass land denial is excluded from Brackets 1-3.
Core: "Extra-turn cards should only appear in low quantities and are not intended to be chained in succession or looped."
The text gives no count for "low quantities". SpellControl reads three or more as a deliberate extra-turn theme (Bracket 3); an actual chain is a Spellbook combo and floors through the combo rule.
Extra turns "not intended to be chained in succession or looped" through Bracket 3; Time Sieve + Thorin is a two-card infinite-turns lock Commander Spellbook rates Ruthless.
Upgraded: "No intentional early-game two-card infinite combos." Commander Spellbook rates this one Ruthless, its call for combos that belong at Bracket 4 and up.
Core: "No intentional two-card infinite combos." Upgraded allows ones that come together late; Spellbook rates this Spicy and the list has no tutors or fast mana to speed it up.

The same Spicy combo with six tutors and three fast-mana pieces (none a Game Changer) can come together early, which Upgraded excludes. How much speed counts as early is SpellControl's acceleration model.
The brackets leave each combo's call to classification; Commander Spellbook rates this one Core (fine at Bracket 2), and the floor follows its rating (E382).
Commander Spellbook rates Approach of the Second Sun + Farsight Ritual Exhibition: no floor.
The commander is always available, so the deck only has to draw one card; Commander Spellbook rates such combos Ruthless.
The brackets restrict two-card infinite combos; a lone three-card line sets no floor (it adds combo-engine points to the power signal).
Two independent complete three-card infinites count as one two-card line (MULTI_CARD_COMBO_WEIGHT), which Core excludes.
Not in the bracket text. Three lock pieces read as a deliberate resource-denial plan (SpellControl rule).
Five lock pieces lock opponents out like land denial (SpellControl rule).

probesAbout: Stability scan probes: one real card per signal the estimator reads (Game Changer, land denial, extra turn, stax, tutor, fast mana, removal, ramp, a vanilla creature, a basic land). Each deck also gets every card that completes one of its one-away combos.
